method:
Measure current point-cloud output on saved raw captures, without tuning.

Recording jitter is not geometric accuracy or two-object resolution. Range
labels from retained experiment notes are used only after extraction. No poses
or object identities are inferred from filenames. Run from the checkout.

recordings.geometry_label: Assumed portrait for archived acquisition; mounting/phase unverified

modal_cell.interpretation: Most frequently detected range/Doppler cell, selected without range labels. Identity is unknown; jitter within this cell excludes other cells and missing frames. Small jitter can describe a stable wrong direction. Response spans are not confidence bounds.

recordings.surveyed_range_hit_interpretation: After-extraction diagnostic, not attributed target detection. Open-door surveyed range refers to the closed pane position. Current cloud extraction excludes native bins 0 and 1.
